package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	redis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
)

// scenario for redis_client_created_per_request: Redis clients created per request instead of reused as shared process infrastructure.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: warning.
func scenario288Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	rdb := redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{
		Addr: "localhost:6379",
	})
	defer rdb.Close()

	val, err := rdb.Get(r.Context(), r.URL.Query().Get("key")).Result()
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Write([]byte(val))
}
